title: The alphabet, one letter at a time
summary: All 26 letters, with handshape descriptions and motion instructions for J and Z.

items.description: Make a fist. Keep your thumb straight up against the side of your pointer finger. Palm faces the camera.
Hold your hand flat, fingers together and pointing up. Fold your thumb across your palm. Palm faces the camera.
Curve your fingers and thumb as if holding a can, leaving a gap between them. Turn your hand so the C faces the side.
Point your pointer finger straight up. Curl your other fingers down to touch your thumb tip, making a small circle. Palm faces the camera.
Bend all four fingers down so their tips rest on your thumb. Tuck your thumb across your palm under them. Palm faces the camera.
Touch your pointer fingertip to your thumb tip to make a circle. Keep your other three fingers up and slightly apart. Palm faces the camera.
Point your pointer finger to the side, with your thumb above it and parallel. Curl your other fingers in. Palm faces you.
Point your pointer and middle fingers to the side, together. Curl your other fingers in. Palm faces you.
Make a fist with your thumb across the front. Raise only your pinky straight up. Palm faces the camera.
Start with your pinky extended and other fingers curled. Draw down, then hook back up with your pinky. Hold briefly at the end.
Raise your pointer finger and middle finger in a V. Press your thumb tip against the middle of your middle finger. Palm faces the camera.
Point your pointer finger up and your thumb out to the side to make an L. Curl your other fingers in. Palm faces the camera.
Make a fist. Tuck your thumb under your pointer, middle and ring fingers so three fingers cover it. Palm faces the camera.
Make a fist. Tuck your thumb under your pointer and middle fingers so two fingers cover it. Palm faces the camera.
Curve all your fingers so their tips touch your thumb tip, making a round O. Turn your hand so the O faces the side.
Make the K shape, then tip your hand so your fingers point down toward the floor.
Make the G shape, then tip your hand so your pointer finger and thumb point down toward the floor.
Raise your pointer and middle fingers and cross them, like fingers crossed for luck. Curl your other fingers in. Palm faces the camera.
Make a fist and wrap your thumb across the front of your fingers. Palm faces the camera.
Make a fist and tuck your thumb between your pointer and middle fingers, tip just showing. Palm faces the camera.
Raise your pointer and middle fingers straight up, pressed together. Hold your other fingers down with your thumb. Palm faces the camera.
Raise your pointer and middle fingers straight up, spread apart. Hold your other fingers down with your thumb. Palm faces the camera.
Raise your pointer, middle and ring fingers, spread apart. Hold your pinky down with your thumb. Palm faces the camera.
Make a fist, then raise your pointer finger and bend it into a hook. Turn your hand so your palm faces the side.
Stretch your thumb and pinky out. Curl your middle three fingers into your palm. Palm faces the camera.
Extend your index finger and curl the other fingers. Trace across, diagonally down and back, then across again. Hold briefly at the end.
